questionHtml: 按 (source_name, external_id) 去重，保留 id 最小的记录，如何写出可审计的 SQL？
answerHtml:
SELECT id
FROM (
  SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY source_name, external_id ORDER BY id) AS rn
  FROM user_imports_raw
) AS marked
WHERE rn > 1
ORDER BY id;
explanationHtml: 排序键决定保留规则，不能省略。删除后应添加唯一键防止复发；如果外部业务允许更新，应改用 UPSERT 而不是定期清理。
